jobs.title: Director-Engineering Design Lead
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

The Global Facilities Delivery (GFD) Organization, part of Corporate Engineering, delivers new and renovated capital assets around the world. Our mission is accomplished through partnerships with design, construction and qualification contractors.

Many of the assets delivered focus on manufacturing of medical innovations and delivering innovative solutions to patients and support an expansion in supply of existing medicines.

Responsibilities For a Director-level DL (Design Lead) Include

Overall design delivery for capital project(s) for a multi-node program or network, and manage a team of DLs on node-level design (manufacturing buildings, utilities, or support systems).
DL teams will be a mixture of Lilly team members and external partners fully accountable in the project location for project technical success.
Directly influences Sr. Management on asset design and/or delivery approaches.
Lead the identification of the applicable Engineering Design Standards, Engineering Functional Standards, Engineering Specifications and Regulatory requirements and guidance (both internal and external).
Actively leads delivery team to expand on their knowledge of design processes based on a history of project delivery.
Coordinate all design for the Project Manager during all design phases of the project and be responsible in delivering the conceptual design review and basic design review.
Direct the development of the design requirements.
Command of the design schedule to meet the project needs.
Often participate in the selection of the A/E firms.
Coordinate with A/E firms to develop earned value progress systems to measure progress by discipline (monitor work versus invoice amounts).
Own design decisions and coordinate information flow between the design team and system owners.
Responsible for ensuring the design meets approved intent through interactions between the design firm, design specialists, engineering tech center disciplines, and end user/customer. Clear articulation of want vs need for asset and facility requirements.
Responsible for design activities and governance, resolving design-related problems.
Examine areas of inefficiency and develop strategies for improvement to direct the design team to meet or improve on the design hours plan.
Instruct the development of standard operating procedures, project delivery work instructions, and/or best practices related to design/verification and ensure they remain current with industry best practices. Influences the network in the adoption of those industry best practices.
Review and approve along with the respective Project Manager the key design project personnel (both internal and external resources).
Work with Engineering Tech Center resources and other key project team technical/constructability resources to address and resolve design issues, and issue formal reports accordingly. Influences key technical decision makers on issues of corporate significance.
Ensures replication is achieved during design when applicable, even in new situations.
Support the Project Manager for value engineering exercises efforts to maximize project opportunities and deliver significant site impact and directly contribute meaningful ways to reduce cost through design.
Participate in KPI reviews/assessments.
Participate in the selection of the verification professional services.
Accountable for the development of the Project Verification Plan, Traceability Matrix, and risk assessments (not necessarily lead the execution).
Coordinate verification for the Project Manager during the verification phase of the project.
Accountable for the discrepancy tracking and management in the Verification phase and uses root cause investigation techniques to resolve problems.

Basic Qualifications

BS in Engineering (Chemical or Mechanical strongly preferred)
Minimum of 20 years manufacturing and/or engineering in support of pharmaceutical or API networks
Ability to work at the site of the project on a weekly basis. This position reports through Indianapolis but is located at site of the supported project.

Additional Preferences

Strong manufacturing and engineering background.

Additional Information

Travel is required for this role (20%, 1-2 weeks/month until relocation to project site)

Join Amgens Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like youre part of something bigger, its because you are. Our shared missionto serve patients living with serious illnessesdrives all that we do.

Since 1980, weve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the worlds toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, youll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, youll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Director Engineering

What You Will Do

Lets do this. Lets change the world. In this role as a member of the AOH Engineering leadership team, the director will provide leadership, strategy, and tactical direction for the engineering and maintenance teams supporting the assembly and packaging lines in AOH 24/7 operation. This position reports directly to the Executive Director F&E and will manage a dynamic team whose responsibilities include engineering and maintenance.

Key Responsibilities Include

Ensure safety of all personnel during plant operations and engineering activities
Ensure that all staff are adequately trained and comply with all GMP standards and procedures
Maximize staff productivity and the efficient use of available resources
Maintain and improve plant capability and equipment reliability in partnership with plant leadership and other technical staff
Leverage resources to support ongoing department capital project investment
Identify areas of potential improvement, conduct analyses, recommend solutions, sponsor improvement projects, and implement as required
Maintain and develop key performance indicators, supervise, assess, and develop staff, and ensure that all targets and milestones are completed on time and on budget
Interface with a diverse Amgen internal network including AOH clients (plant and area directors and front-line managers), Facilities & Engineering leadership (Engineering and Automation), Engineering Technical Authority, Technology, Global Capital Project Management, Environmental Health and Safety, and Process Development

Specific Responsibilities Include

Oversee a safe and compliant workforce working with a highly utilized commercial operations site
Provide day-to-day, small project, and plant shut-down support
Work with a diverse group of clients, technologies, and integrated systems in product development all in a GMP and highly regulated setting
Manage partners and drive new business processes to ensure continuous and sustained improvements
Ensure readiness and compliance for internal audits, external agency audits, and partner visits
Present engineering plans, progress, and status updates to project stakeholders
Review and approve proposed engineering designs, and equipment improvements and changes
Perform administrative and oversight functions in approving proposals and expenditures
Participate in the development of department expenditure requests and partner with the projects teams to define the best engineering solution inclusive of long-term equipment performance
Deliver effective troubleshooting and timely response to reduce downtime
Drive robust equipment reliability

What We Expect Of You

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The engineering professional we seek is a leader and a strong strategic problem solver with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications

Doctorate degree and 4 years of Manufacturing, Packaging or Quality experience in pharmaceutical, medical device or biotechnology companies experience

OR

Masters degree and 8 years of Manufacturing, Packaging or Quality experience in pharmaceutical, medical device or biotechnology companies experience

OR

Bachelors degree and 10 years of Manufacturing, Packaging or Quality experience in pharmaceutical, medical device or biotechnology companies experience

In addition to meeting at least one of the above requirements, you must have at least 4 years experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs, or directing the allocation or resources. Your managerial experience may run concurrently with the required technical experience referenced above

Preferred Qualifications

Typically, 12+ years of relevant work experience with 8+ years experience in an operations / manufacturing environment
Typically, 10+ years experience with regulated environments (i.e. FDA/cGMP, OSHA, EPA) preferred
Must have experience leading an engineering department in a regulated GMP environment
Knowledge of GMP manufacturing equipment and their design and operational aspects
Excellent organizational and administrative leadership skills
Ability to work and influence locally and across Amgens network
Ability to work in a highly dynamic organization with a demanding environment
Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills, as well as the ability to actively, and cooperatively work with cross-functional teams
Demonstrated team motivation, leadership, and mentoring/staff development skills
Understand regulatory trends in the industry. Direct experience with FDA or equivalent regulatory body
Ability to manage multiple resource demands and prioritization, assess project effectiveness, and efficiency and manage demand
Proven ability to motivate staff and establish and communicate visions/missions
Proven ability to delegate and manage the work of others
Demonstrate a high degree of creativity, foresight, and mature judgment in anticipating and solving problems by translating data into actionable solutions

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, well support your journey every step of the way.

jobs.description:
About EAB

At EAB , our mission is to make education smarter and our communities stronger. We work with more than 2,800 institutions to drive transformative change through data-driven insights and best-in-class capabilities. From kindergarten to college to career, EAB partners with leaders and practitioners to accelerate progress and drive results across enrollment, student success, institutional strategy, data analytics, and advancement. We work with each partner differently, tailoring our portfolio of research, technology, and marketing and enrollment solutions to meet the unique needs of every leadership team, as well as the students and employees they serve.

At EAB, we serve not only our partner institutions but each other—that's why we are always working to make sure our employees love their jobs and are invested in their communities. See how we've been recognized for this dedication to our employees by checking out our recent awards .

For more information, visit our Careers page.

The Role In Brief

Director, Data Engineering

The Director of Data Engineering for Navigate360 leads the team responsible for implementing Navigate360 data integrations across partner campuses. This role oversees delivery for Navigate Student Success, EAB’s foundational student success technology, while charting and scaling implementation practices for newer Navigate Enrollment CRM and Advancement CRM offerings. The role combines people leadership, technical and operational judgment, and a partner-first mindset to help campuses realize successful, durable implementations. Working at the intersection of data, product, and customer outcomes, this leader establishes clear operating processes, removes barriers, and ensures the team delivers reliable integrations that create value in practice.

This position is ideally based out of EAB’s Washington, D.C. office or Richmond, VA office. It is also open to remote work within the continental U.S.

This hire may be required to travel to EAB’s central office in Washington, D.C. on a quarterly basis, and occasionally visit partners to firm up engagement and kick off high-touch projects. The current travel expectation does not exceed 12 days per year.

Primary Responsibilities

Lead, coach, and develop a team of data engineers implementing Navigate modules for partner campuses; set clear expectations, priorities, and delivery standards.
Own the implementation approach for Navigate Student Success and help define scalable delivery practices for newer Navigate Enrollment CRM and Advancement CRM offerings.
Establish repeatable processes, playbooks, and quality controls that enable the team to deliver high-quality data integrations consistently at scale.
Unblock partner-facing and technical challenges throughout implementation projects, escalating and coordinating decisions as needed to protect partner outcomes.
Partner with Product on data-integration issues, requirements, and product enhancements that improve implementation quality and the partner experience.
Collaborate closely with Launch and Partner Success teams to align implementation plans, manage risk, and support successful partner adoption and outcomes.
Guide solution design for integrations, data mapping, validation, reconciliation, and data quality across all Navigate implementations.
Oversee delivery planning, capacity, and project health across the team; use organized, methodical processes to manage competing priorities and drive predictable execution.
Foster a culture of technical excellence through mentoring, thoughtful code and design review, documentation, and continuous improvement of team practices.
Represent the Data Engineering team with internal and external stakeholders, communicating progress, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations with clarity and credibility.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience
8+ years of database programming experience, including advanced SQL
3-4+ years leading, managing, or serving as a team lead for data engineering teams
Experience delivering data integration, warehousing, or analytics solutions in partner-facing or customer implementation environments
2+ years of Python programming experience for relational data management, including commonly used data-management libraries
Deep understanding of how data flows across systems, including ETL pipelines, data mapping, validation, and reconciliation
Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical and partner challenges, make sound decisions, and unblock teams
Experience ensuring data integrity through standard rules, procedures, testing, validation, and quality controls
Highly organized, process-oriented, and effective at managing multiple priorities in a changing environment; strong written and verbal communication skills

Ideal Qualifications

Master’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience
Experience working directly with external partners and executive stakeholders to solve problems, build trust, and drive successful implementations
Practical knowledge of data warehouse design, scalable data pipelines, integrations across platforms, and complex stored procedures
Experience leading teams through growth, change, and continuous improvement, including developing repeatable operating processes
Ability to work collaboratively across Product, Launch, Partner Success, and technical teams to accomplish shared partner outcomes in a fast-paced environment
Commitment to a continual learning environment and to a dynamic, welcoming culture of fairness, authenticity, and belonging in support of EAB’s mission, values, and aspiration

If you’ve reached this section of the job description and are unsure of whether to apply, please do! At EAB, we welcome new perspectives and learn from each other’s unique experiences. We would encourage you to submit an application if this is a role you would be passionate about doing every day.

Compensation

The anticipated starting salary range for this role is $103,500 – $130,000 per year. Actual salary varies due to factors that may include but not be limited to relevant experience, skills, and location. At EAB, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the starting salary range for their role.

This hire will additionally be eligible for discretionary bonus or incentive compensation. Variable compensation may depend on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Benefits

Consistent with our belief that our employees are our most valuable resource, EAB offers a competitive and inclusive benefits package. Our benefits currently include:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans; dependents and domestic partners eligible
20+ days of PTO annually, in addition to paid firm and floating holidays
Daytime leave policy for community service and flextime for fitness activities (up to 10 hours per month each)
401(k) retirement savings plan with annual discretionary company matching contribution
Health savings account, healthcare and dependent care flexible spending account, and pre-tax commuter plans
Employee assistance program with counseling services and resources available to all employees and immediate family
Wellness programs including gym discounts, incentives to promote healthy living, and family access to the leading app for sleep, meditation, and relaxation
Fertility treatment coverage and adoption or surrogacy assistance
Paid parental leave with phase back to work program for birthing and non-birthing parents
Access to milk shipping service to support nursing employees during business travel
Discounted pet health insurance coverage for dog and cat family members
Company-provided life, AD&D, and disability insurance
Financial wellness resources and membership in a robust employee discount program
Access to employee resource groups, merit-based advancement, and dynamic professional growth opportunities

Benefits kick in day one; learn more at eab.com/careers/benefits .

jobs.title: Director, Platform Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description

Team Description:

As a Director in Oracle Health Core Platforms Operations, you will lead the Citrix Platform organization and the stability, modernization, and operational-health agenda for a critical customer-facing platform. You will set strategy and execution priorities across Gen1 stability, incident and CAPA follow-through, technology currency, security, capacity, Millennium health, critical projects, and Move to OCI Operations/Support handoff standardization. You will influence senior leaders and technical teams across organizational boundaries to deliver measurable improvements in customer reliability and execution discipline.

You will lead managers, senior technical leaders, and engineers responsible for operating and improving the Citrix platform supporting US and global customers. You will establish clear portfolio ownership, align teams on shared outcomes, and ensure dependencies, risks, and decisions are actively managed through closure.

This role requires a leader who can translate complex operational and technical signals into an integrated plan, remove barriers, make timely tradeoffs, and communicate progress and risk credibly to Senior Directors, VPs, and peer organizations. You will build an environment of accountability, learning, and continuous improvement while maintaining a strong focus on customer impact.

The Director will be central to sustaining platform stability while advancing modernization. The role will drive cross-functional improvement across incident and T3 reduction, resiliency and CAPA actions, observability, Windows technology currency, OLVM burndown, security and credential initiatives, capacity reviews, and service-health programs.

Org:

Leads a platform group; develops strategies and plans that standardize runtimes, APIs, and SDKs across several teams. Accountable for group results and governance adherence; makes operational decisions ensuring compatibility, security, and performance. Sponsors cross-group innovation in resilience, capacity modeling, and interoperability. Communicates with executive leadership on platform health, risk, and adoption.

Responsibilities

Team Responsibilities:

Own the Citrix Platform operating strategy, roadmap, and delivery plan, balancing immediate customer-impacting priorities with durable reliability and modernization outcomes.
Lead and develop an organization of managers and technical professionals; establish clear accountabilities, performance expectations, succession depth, and an inclusive, high-performing culture.
Drive Gen1 stability and wellness improvements through disciplined incident, T3, problem-management, CAPA, and resiliency practices; ensure actions have accountable owners, evidence of closure, and measurable outcomes.
Coordinate cross-organization priorities for observability, telemetry, service health, capacity planning, Windows technology currency, OLVM reduction, security remediation, and credential lifecycle work.
Provide senior operational leadership during significant customer-impacting incidents and escalations, ensuring timely decision-making, transparent communication, and rigorous follow-through.
Partner with engineering, security, infrastructure, OCI, Millennium, and support organizations to remove dependencies and standardize the Move to OCI Operations/Support handoff model.
Define and review operational health metrics, trends, risks, and commitments; use data to prioritize investments and communicate progress to executive stakeholders.
Sponsor critical projects that improve platform reliability, scalability, operational efficiency, and the customer experience across global production environments.
Manage resource allocation and sequencing across operational commitments and strategic initiatives, escalating tradeoffs early when customer or delivery risk requires leadership action.

Team Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline; or equivalent relevant experience.
10+ years of progressive experience in technology operations, infrastructure, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, or enterprise application delivery.
7+ years of experience leading managers and technical teams in complex, customer-facing production environments.
Demonstrated success improving reliability, incident response, problem management, CAPA execution, and operational health for large-scale services.
Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure and platform operations, including virtualization, Windows technologies, networking, identity or credential management, observability, capacity, and security controls.
Proven ability to lead across organizational boundaries, influence senior stakeholders, make sound risk-based decisions, and communicate clearly during high-pressure situations.
Strong analytical, program-management, and people-leadership skills, with a track record of translating strategy into measurable execution outcomes.
Experience supporting healthcare, regulated, or mission-critical customer environments is preferred.

Org Responsibilities

Platform Software Development:

Define platform strategy for a group, aligning runtimes, SDKs, and integration frameworks to interoperable, multi-tenant standards.
Govern cross-group compatibility and security controls with SRE/security partners; approve high-risk migrations and deprecations.
Own group-wide resilience and capacity objectives; institutionalize rollout, canary, and rollback patterns across services.

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:

Defines key elements for leads and/or teams to design multiple software solutions and identify and analyze requirements to ensure alignment with business and organizational goals.
Applies broad understanding of other areas within the organization to develop and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and to develop documents to clarify software design and code.
Leads design and specification reviews to drive improvements across multiple projects/programs.
Utilizes conceptual thinking to direct leads and/or teams for conducting debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix software issues.
Directs leads and/or teams to implement software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging.
Drives the optimization of design and development practices to improve performance across products and domains, ensuring adherence to organizational goals in execution of business priorities.
Directs teams in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.
Directs teams to implement API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:

Directs teams to design and develop software, systems, and services.
Coaches managers to provide technical guidance and domain expertise in software architecture decisions and best practices.
Utilizes conceptual thinking to direct teams in conducting periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural standards.
Collaborates with cross-functional teams and stakeholders within and outside the organization to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities in focus.
Directs teams to implement performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.
Defines processes and approaches to conduct regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements.

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:

Collaborates with stakeholders within and outside of organization, including executive leadership, to understand customer issues and align solutions.
Directs teams to provide technical guidance and appropriately prioritize support to customers regarding reported issues.
Leads teams and sets direction to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback.
Influences multiple teams to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.
Directs the implementation of training for customer issue and/or defect handling processes.
Leads the investigation and troubleshooting of complex and broadly reaching product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions.

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:

Collaborates with teams and leadership to establish, follow, and enforce documented security criteria, evolving/dynamic industry best practices and processes, and coding standards.
Ensures clarity on key elements and objectives for adherence to broad acceptance criteria to impact development processes in the organization.
Implements complex secure software development practices to prevent security vulnerabilities that affect the organization.

Development Operations - System Maintenance:

At EAB , our mission is to make education smarter and our communities stronger. We work with more than 2,800 institutions to drive transformative change through data-driven insights and best-in-class capabilities. From kindergarten to college to career, EAB partners with leaders and practitioners to accelerate progress and drive results across enrollment, student success, institutional strategy, data analytics, and advancement. We work with each partner differently, tailoring our portfolio of research, technology, and marketing and enrollment solutions to meet the unique needs of every leadership team, as well as the students and employees they serve.

At EAB, we serve not only our partner institutions but each other—that's why we are always working to make sure our employees love their jobs and are invested in their communities. See how we've been recognized for this dedication to our employees by checking out our recent awards .

For more information, visit our Careers page.

The Role In Brief

Director, Data Engineering

The Director of Data Engineering for Navigate360 leads the team responsible for implementing Navigate360 data integrations across partner campuses. This role oversees delivery for Navigate Student Success, EAB’s foundational student success technology, while charting and scaling implementation practices for newer Navigate Enrollment CRM and Advancement CRM offerings. The role combines people leadership, technical and operational judgment, and a partner-first mindset to help campuses realize successful, durable implementations. Working at the intersection of data, product, and customer outcomes, this leader establishes clear operating processes, removes barriers, and ensures the team delivers reliable integrations that create value in practice.

This position is ideally based out of EAB’s Washington, D.C. office or Richmond, VA office. It is also open to remote work within the continental U.S.

This hire may be required to travel to EAB’s central office in Washington, D.C. on a quarterly basis, and occasionally visit partners to firm up engagement and kick off high-touch projects. The current travel expectation does not exceed 12 days per year.

Primary Responsibilities

Lead, coach, and develop a team of data engineers implementing Navigate modules for partner campuses; set clear expectations, priorities, and delivery standards.
Own the implementation approach for Navigate Student Success and help define scalable delivery practices for newer Navigate Enrollment CRM and Advancement CRM offerings.
Establish repeatable processes, playbooks, and quality controls that enable the team to deliver high-quality data integrations consistently at scale.
Unblock partner-facing and technical challenges throughout implementation projects, escalating and coordinating decisions as needed to protect partner outcomes.
Partner with Product on data-integration issues, requirements, and product enhancements that improve implementation quality and the partner experience.
Collaborate closely with Launch and Partner Success teams to align implementation plans, manage risk, and support successful partner adoption and outcomes.
Guide solution design for integrations, data mapping, validation, reconciliation, and data quality across all Navigate implementations.
Oversee delivery planning, capacity, and project health across the team; use organized, methodical processes to manage competing priorities and drive predictable execution.
Foster a culture of technical excellence through mentoring, thoughtful code and design review, documentation, and continuous improvement of team practices.
Represent the Data Engineering team with internal and external stakeholders, communicating progress, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations with clarity and credibility.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience
8+ years of database programming experience, including advanced SQL
3-4+ years leading, managing, or serving as a team lead for data engineering teams
Experience delivering data integration, warehousing, or analytics solutions in partner-facing or customer implementation environments
2+ years of Python programming experience for relational data management, including commonly used data-management libraries
Deep understanding of how data flows across systems, including ETL pipelines, data mapping, validation, and reconciliation
Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical and partner challenges, make sound decisions, and unblock teams
Experience ensuring data integrity through standard rules, procedures, testing, validation, and quality controls
Highly organized, process-oriented, and effective at managing multiple priorities in a changing environment; strong written and verbal communication skills

Ideal Qualifications

Master’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience
Experience working directly with external partners and executive stakeholders to solve problems, build trust, and drive successful implementations
Practical knowledge of data warehouse design, scalable data pipelines, integrations across platforms, and complex stored procedures
Experience leading teams through growth, change, and continuous improvement, including developing repeatable operating processes
Ability to work collaboratively across Product, Launch, Partner Success, and technical teams to accomplish shared partner outcomes in a fast-paced environment
Commitment to a continual learning environment and to a dynamic, welcoming culture of fairness, authenticity, and belonging in support of EAB’s mission, values, and aspiration

If you’ve reached this section of the job description and are unsure of whether to apply, please do! At EAB, we welcome new perspectives and learn from each other’s unique experiences. We would encourage you to submit an application if this is a role you would be passionate about doing every day.

Compensation

The anticipated starting salary range for this role is $103,500 – $130,000 per year. Actual salary varies due to factors that may include but not be limited to relevant experience, skills, and location. At EAB, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the starting salary range for their role.

This hire will additionally be eligible for discretionary bonus or incentive compensation. Variable compensation may depend on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Benefits

Consistent with our belief that our employees are our most valuable resource, EAB offers a competitive and inclusive benefits package. Our benefits currently include:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans; dependents and domestic partners eligible
20+ days of PTO annually, in addition to paid firm and floating holidays
Daytime leave policy for community service and flextime for fitness activities (up to 10 hours per month each)
401(k) retirement savings plan with annual discretionary company matching contribution
Health savings account, healthcare and dependent care flexible spending account, and pre-tax commuter plans
Employee assistance program with counseling services and resources available to all employees and immediate family
Wellness programs including gym discounts, incentives to promote healthy living, and family access to the leading app for sleep, meditation, and relaxation
Fertility treatment coverage and adoption or surrogacy assistance
Paid parental leave with phase back to work program for birthing and non-birthing parents
Access to milk shipping service to support nursing employees during business travel
Discounted pet health insurance coverage for dog and cat family members
Company-provided life, AD&D, and disability insurance

Access to employee resource groups, merit-based advancement, and dynamic professional growth opportunities

This position is based in Abilene, TX.

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is continuing its rapid expansion across parts of North America, delivering next-generation cloud infrastructure to support enterprise and AI-driven workloads. As our cloud footprint continues to grow, we are seeking an accomplished executive to lead Cloud Hardware Support (CHS) across parts of North America.

This Senior Director will provide strategic and operational leadership for a rapidly growing regional organization, with responsibility spanning Build & Deployment, steady-state operations, hardware maintenance, and break-fix support across Oracle's cloud infrastructure.

The successful candidate will establish a scalable operating model that enables rapid regional expansion while maintaining operational excellence, customer service, and workforce effectiveness. This leader will build high-performing teams, standardize operations across multiple countries, and drive continuous improvement through automation, AI, process engineering, and operational innovation.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of Oracle's cloud operations across one of its fastest-growing regions.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

We are seeking a dynamic and visionary executive with a proven track record of leading hyperscale infrastructure organizations through periods of rapid growth and transformation. This leader will be responsible for scaling Cloud Hardware Support operations across parts of North America while ensuring the organization remains operationally efficient, customer-focused, and ready to support Oracle's continued cloud expansion.

Additional responsibilities include:

Provide executive leadership for Cloud Hardware Support operations across parts of North America, including Build & Deployment, production readiness, hardware lifecycle management, and break-fix operations.
Develop and execute a scalable regional operating model capable of supporting continued hyperscale growth across multiple countries.
Lead a large, geographically dispersed organization that is expected to grow significantly as Oracle expands its cloud footprint throughout the region.
Drive operational excellence by standardizing deployment methodologies, improving service delivery, and implementing best practices across all regional operations.
Champion the use of AI, automation, process engineering, and data-driven decision making to improve productivity, increase operational efficiency, and reduce the dependency between infrastructure growth and headcount expansion.
Build and develop high-performing leadership teams while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Partner closely with Engineering, Networking, Software Development, Product, Supply Chain, Data Center Engineering, and other cross-functional organizations to ensure successful delivery of new cloud regions and ongoing operational excellence.
Establish strong contractor, partner, and vendor relationships to support regional deployment and operational readiness.
Ensure customer commitments and operational service levels are consistently achieved while proactively managing operational risk.
Act as the senior Cloud Hardware Support leader across parts of North America, influencing strategic priorities and representing the organization with executive stakeholders across Oracle.

Preferred Skills And Experience

Executive leadership experience within hyperscale cloud infrastructure, cloud operations, hardware support, data center operations, or infrastructure engineering.
Proven experience leading large, geographically distributed organizations across multiple countries and cultures.
Demonstrated success scaling operations within rapidly growing cloud or technology organizations.

Exceptional strategic thinking, organizational leadership, and execution capabilities.
Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across engineering, infrastructure, product, and business organizations.
Experience building high-performing leadership teams and developing organizational capability through periods of significant growth.
Demonstrated ability to manage complex regional operations while balancing customer requirements, operational excellence, and business priorities.

Performance, drive, and execution—Holds self and others accountable for delivering shareholder value. Creates and instills a performance driven, results-orientation culture based on data and facts. Collaboration—Fosters collaboration between business leaders. Facilitates consensus among diverse stakeholders with opposing viewpoints on critical issues. Drives a diverse and inclusive culture throughout the organization. Instills a sense of common purpose, joint mission, and mutual responsibility to create and support business outcomes. Communicating for impact—Ensures clarity around organization's strategic intent and business objectives. Champions strategic initiatives in ways that generate organization-wide understanding and support. Builds confidence and inspires support through a convincing presentation style.
Inspirational leadership—Establishes and models authentic leadership across internal and external boundaries. Builds internal and external reputation as a strategic business leader. Job Description

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineering Manager to lead the engineering strategy, delivery, and technical execution of software applications across a diverse portfolio of business-critical platforms, products, integrations, and modernization initiatives.

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role. The successful candidate must bring the same technical depth, engineering judgment, and delivery credibility expected of a Principal Software Engineer, while also leading teams, growing talent, and driving execution across a complex application portfolio. This role is not intended for an architect-only or people-only leader. The right candidate is expected to stay close to the code, lead technical design, perform code reviews, solve complex engineering problems, and coach engineers through direct technical engagement and example.

What You Will Do

Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for the design, build, modernization, integration, and support of software applications
Own technical direction across a portfolio that includes modern platforms, business-critical applications, integrations, APIs, and legacy systems
Partner with product, business, architecture, operations, and delivery leaders to translate business needs into scalable engineering solutions
Drive modernization strategies for legacy applications, including decomposition, platform evolution, integration simplification, and reduction of technical debt
Act as the senior technical leader for the organization by making sound architecture decisions, reviewing designs, and setting a high bar for engineering quality
Contribute directly when needed through design reviews, debugging, code reviews, solution modeling, technical spike work, and hands-on problem solving
Establish and enforce strong software engineering practices including testing, observability, CI/CD, version control discipline, secure coding, and operational readiness
Build strong engineering teams by hiring, coaching, mentoring, and developing software engineers and technical leaders
Create a culture of accountability, technical excellence, continuous learning, and customer-focused delivery
Lead incident response and escalation management for critical production issues, ensuring fast resolution and durable corrective action
Manage delivery across multiple workstreams with clear prioritization, measurable outcomes, and transparent communication to stakeholders

What Makes This Role Different

This leader is expected to operate with principal-level engineering capability, not simply manage engineers
The role requires strong technical credibility across application architecture, software delivery, integration patterns, modernization, and production support
The leader must be able to challenge designs, improve implementation approaches, and personally help teams through difficult technical situations
Success in this role depends on balancing strategic leadership with direct engineering engagement

Your Skills And Abilities (Required Qualifications)

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
10+ years experience in software engineering, with progressive responsibility across application development, and 5+ years of technical people leadership experience
Proven experience leading engineering teams and engineering managers responsible for complex enterprise application portfolios
Deep hands-on experience in software design, coding, code review, debugging, and technical problem solving
Demonstrated success modernizing legacy systems while supporting ongoing delivery for business-critical applications
Strong understanding of distributed systems, application integration, APIs, event-driven patterns, data flows, and enterprise architecture
Experience establishing and improving engineering standards, development lifecycle practices, and delivery discipline
Ability to lead across ambiguity, influence senior stakeholders, and align technical decisions with business outcomes
Strong coaching and mentoring capability, with a track record of raising the technical effectiveness of engineers and managers
Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to both engineering and business audiences

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

12+ years experience in software engineering, with progressive responsibility across application development, and 7+ years of technical people leadership experience
Experience supporting complex customer-facing, operational, or enterprise business domains
Experience with legacy platform transformation, including mainframe-connected or deeply integrated enterprise systems
Experience with cloud platforms, DevOps tooling, automated testing, observability, and modern software delivery practices
Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams
Experience operating in environments that require both speed of delivery and high operational reliability

What you'll do...

Role summary:

Walmart’s Item Experience & Content Strategy organization is looking for a strategic and action-oriented leader to shape how hundreds of millions of customers discover, browse, and shop online. As the Senior Manager of Trend Intelligence on the Social Commerce team, you will lead the strategic management, automation, and delivery of initiatives that turn trend and social signals into actionable insights and customer experiences. This is a highly cross-functional, high-impact opportunity to scale Walmart's Trend Hub, leveraging social data pipelines to influence the end-to-end customer journey on Walmart.com.

About the team:

Walmart is redefining the ways we discover and shop by blending content, culture, and commerce. The Social Commerce team helps power this transformation by building cutting-edge experiences on-site, enabling new sources for rich content, leveraging creator and community-led insight, and scaling trend intelligence across the enterprise. Alongside our Item Experience and Content Strategy teammates, we aim to make Walmart the most insightful, engaging, and effortless place to shop.

What you'll do:

Define Walmart’s trend-understanding, owning the data pipeline from social signals to centralized insight.
Manage relationships with data providers, evaluate emerging sources, lead partner negotiations, and drive integration prioritization for Trend Hub.
Partner with Product and Engineering to refine trend-understanding logic, enhance internal dashboards, and maximize insight visibility.
Collaborate across Walmart to integrate trends into various org/team workflows, helping stakeholders build trend-informed features that elevate customer experiences.
Leverage data analysis/modeling to handle large datasets, validate logic, and turn raw data into recommendations.
Develop business cases and roadmaps to pitch ideas, influence priority, and secure buy-in from leadership.
Turn ambiguous challenges into actionable playbooks, long-term strategy, and automation.

What you'll bring:

Action-Oriented Leadership: Ability to thrive in ambiguity, applying structure and robust frameworks to accelerate end-to-end results.
Strategic Problem-Solving: Strong analytical mindset to develop long-term, sustainable solutions to complex operations issues in real-time.
Data-centricity: Proven ability to leverage data insights to inform strategic decisions, identify business opportunities, and validate processes.
Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of the social platform landscape, trend-detection tools, and modern social commerce innovations.
Executive Storytelling: Exceptional storytelling capabilities, with the ability to construct and deliver audience-specific, enterprise-level narratives.
Collaborative Ownership: Proactive leadership style, demonstrating the ability to manage complex initiatives independently while unifying cross-functional teams.

Detailed Job Description

Job Overview

The Executive Director of Technology Operations is responsible for leading the operational management, governance, and execution of the company’s technology organization. This role ensures that technology resources, systems, infrastructure, development processes, and operational activities are aligned with business objectives and delivered efficiently, securely, and at scale.

The Executive Director of Technology Operations serves as the critical bridge between technology strategy and operational execution, driving operational excellence, technology governance, digital transformation, and cross-functional collaboration to support sustainable business growth and innovation.

Key Responsibilities
I. Technology Operations Strategy and Execution

Develop and implement technology operations strategies aligned with corporate and technology objectives.
Translate technology roadmaps into operational plans and measurable outcomes.
Drive operational excellence across software development, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud operations, and IT service delivery.
Establish governance frameworks to ensure efficient execution of technology initiatives.

II. Technology Program and Portfolio Management

Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of enterprise technology projects and programs.
Manage technology portfolios, budgets, resources, and priorities to maximize business value.
Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
Develop executive dashboards and reporting mechanisms to provide visibility into technology performance.

III. Technology Process Optimization and Governance

Establish and standardize technology operational processes, policies, and procedures.
Implement best practices across software development lifecycle (SDLC), DevOps, ITSM, Agile, and project management disciplines.
Continuously improve operational efficiency through process automation and workflow optimization.
Ensure compliance with internal controls, governance standards, and regulatory requirements.

IV. Infrastructure, Cloud, and Service Operations

Oversee enterprise technology infrastructure, cloud platforms, networks, and operational support services.
Ensure system availability, scalability, reliability, and performance.
Drive service delivery excellence through effective monitoring, incident management, and problem resolution.

Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to ensure protection of enterprise systems, applications, and data assets.
Identify and mitigate technology-related operational risks.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, security frameworks, and corporate governance requirements.
Establish risk management and escalation procedures for critical technology operations.

VI. Data, Analytics, and Performance Management

Define and monitor technology KPIs, SLAs, and operational performance metrics.
Utilize data analytics to improve operational efficiency and support decision-making.
Develop performance reporting frameworks for executive leadership.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on operational insights and business needs.

VII. Cross-functional Collaboration and Business Alignment

Partner with product management, engineering, IT, finance, HR, and business leaders to align technology operations with business priorities.
Facilitate communication between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Support enterprise transformation initiatives and technology-enabled business growth.
Ensure effective coordination across global technology teams.

VIII. Leadership and Organizational Development

Build and lead high-performing technology operations teams.
Develop leadership capabilities, succession planning, and talent development programs.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
Promote employee engagement and collaboration across technology functions.

From kindergarten to college to career, EAB partners with leaders and practitioners to accelerate progress and drive results across enrollment, student success, institutional strategy, data analytics, and advancement. For more information, visit our Careers page.

The Role In Brief

Director, Data Engineering

The Director of Data Engineering for Navigate360 leads the team responsible for implementing Navigate360 data integrations across partner campuses. This role oversees delivery for Navigate Student Success, EAB’s foundational student success technology, while charting and scaling implementation practices for newer Navigate Enrollment CRM and Advancement CRM offerings. The role combines people leadership, technical and operational judgment, and a partner-first mindset to help campuses realize successful, durable implementations. Working at the intersection of data, product, and customer outcomes, this leader establishes clear operating processes, removes barriers, and ensures the team delivers reliable integrations that create value in practice.

This position is ideally based out of EAB’s Washington, D.C. office or Richmond, VA office. It is also open to remote work within the continental U.S.

This hire may be required to travel to EAB’s central office in Washington, D.C. on a quarterly basis, and occasionally visit partners to firm up engagement and kick off high-touch projects. The current travel expectation does not exceed 12 days per year.

Primary Responsibilities

Lead, coach, and develop a team of data engineers implementing Navigate modules for partner campuses; set clear expectations, priorities, and delivery standards.
Own the implementation approach for Navigate Student Success and help define scalable delivery practices for newer Navigate Enrollment CRM and Advancement CRM offerings.
Establish repeatable processes, playbooks, and quality controls that enable the team to deliver high-quality data integrations consistently at scale.
Unblock partner-facing and technical challenges throughout implementation projects, escalating and coordinating decisions as needed to protect partner outcomes.
Partner with Product on data-integration issues, requirements, and product enhancements that improve implementation quality and the partner experience.
Collaborate closely with Launch and Partner Success teams to align implementation plans, manage risk, and support successful partner adoption and outcomes.
Guide solution design for integrations, data mapping, validation, reconciliation, and data quality across all Navigate implementations.
Oversee delivery planning, capacity, and project health across the team; use organized, methodical processes to manage competing priorities and drive predictable execution.
Foster a culture of technical excellence through mentoring, thoughtful code and design review, documentation, and continuous improvement of team practices.
Represent the Data Engineering team with internal and external stakeholders, communicating progress, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations with clarity and credibility.

8+ years of database programming experience, including advanced SQL
3-4+ years leading, managing, or serving as a team lead for data engineering teams
Experience delivering data integration, warehousing, or analytics solutions in partner-facing or customer implementation environments

Deep understanding of how data flows across systems, including ETL pipelines, data mapping, validation, and reconciliation
Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical and partner challenges, make sound decisions, and unblock teams
Experience ensuring data integrity through standard rules, procedures, testing, validation, and quality controls
Highly organized, process-oriented, and effective at managing multiple priorities in a changing environment; strong written and verbal communication skills

Experience working directly with external partners and executive stakeholders to solve problems, build trust, and drive successful implementations
Practical knowledge of data warehouse design, scalable data pipelines, integrations across platforms, and complex stored procedures
Experience leading teams through growth, change, and continuous improvement, including developing repeatable operating processes
